body.text: PHASE-LOCK THE FINANCE AND CLI WORK THROUGH CANONICAL STATE. Select one exact current Run8 model occurrence already represented by the finance path. The finance side must name its stable canonical occurrence/usage/economic/evidence refs. Independently, the shell/native-Power side must reach that SAME occurrence from a semantic address and deterministic operators (equivalent to @work/<id> |> ?realizations |> ?usage |> ?economics |> ?evidence). A non-originating epoch then compares identity, cardinality, unknown fields, and evidence lineage. Pass only if both paths converge on the same underlying occurrence(s) without a shell-owned shadow ledger, duplicate finance object, guessed historic model/token fields, or loss of retry identity. If they diverge, emit trace_divergence with the exact boundary. This is communication through shared canonical objects, not prose status.

subject: Dual-key rendezvous: finance and shell must meet on one exact occurrence
